title: The Sad Puppy Who Got a Warm Hug: Comforting a Friend!

lines.text: Buster the little puppy was tossing his favorite red bouncy ball in the park!
lines.caps: Buster the little puppy was tossing his favorite red bouncy *BALL | in the *PARK!

lines.text: Plop! The ball rolled straight into a murky mud puddle and sank out of reach!
lines.caps: *PLOP! The ball rolled straight into a murky mud puddle and sank out of *REACH!

lines.text: Buster sat on the grass, whimpered softly, and let his floppy ears droop down in sadness!
lines.caps: Buster sat on the grass, whimpered softly, and let his floppy ears droop down in *SADNESS!

lines.text: Leo noticed his friend's tears from across the playground and hurried over!
lines.caps: Leo noticed his friend's tears from across the playground and hurried *OVER!

lines.text: He didn't say Stop crying or It's just a toy! He simply sat beside Buster on the grass!
lines.caps: He didn't say Stop crying or It's just a toy! He simply sat beside Buster on the *GRASS!

lines.text: Leo wrapped his arms around Buster in a warm, gentle, reassuring hug!
lines.caps: Leo wrapped his arms around Buster in a warm, gentle, reassuring *HUG!

lines.text: A warm hug releases calming happy hormones that soothe racing hearts and bring peace!
lines.caps: A warm hug releases calming happy hormones that soothe racing hearts and bring *PEACE!

lines.text: Buster licked Leo's cheek, wagged his tail, and together they fished the muddy ball out!
lines.caps: Buster licked Leo's cheek, wagged his tail, and together they fished the muddy *BALL | *OUT!

lines.text: Comfort your friends and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily kindness!
lines.caps: *COMFORT your friends | and *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily *KINDNESS!
